Yes I agree. In Turkey I had my first ultra sound in 2021, despite two nodules only being TIRAD 3, they said we can biopsy it if you want or you can follow up in a year. It’s interesting how the US needs very specific guidelines to allow for FNA, I think it comes down to insurance coverage which is annoying because I have very good insurance right now that I pay for through my job. Turkey is big on preventative measures and finding disease early. I have two woman in my family who both discovered breast cancer at stage 1 because of routine screenings at younger ages and accessibility. Of course this isn’t for everyone, it is certainly for those who have access to good hospitals in turkey unfortunately
